description: This file defines the ObjectUploader class in the AWS SDK for PHP, responsible for uploading objects to Amazon S3, supporting both simple and multipart uploads.

classes.name: ObjectUploader
classes.description: Handles uploading objects to Amazon S3 with support for multipart uploads and configurable options.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes an ObjectUploader instance with S3 client, target bucket, key, body, ACL, and options.

methods.name: promise
methods.description: Returns a promise that resolves when the upload completes, choosing multipart or simple upload based on size.

methods.name: upload
methods.description: Performs the upload and waits for its completion.

methods.name: requiresMultipart
methods.description: Determines if the upload should be multipart based on body size and threshold.
